positions.thesis: Long SPY for core equity beta because the trend remains intact and a day-one book needs market exposure; wrong if it closes below 718 (about -4.9%) by 2026-12-31.
Long SMH because semis lead the tape and AI capex momentum is underpriced in a trending market; wrong if it closes below 460 (about -6%) by 2026-12-31.
Long GLD as a diversifier against the equity exposure, because gold has trended up and offsets equity drawdowns; wrong if it closes below 362 (about -4.7%) by 2027-01-31.

positions.thesis: Long BTC because the post-halving bear is ~12 months old and $75K sits ~40% off the cycle top — the late-stage zone where deep-value mean reversion historically begins; bounce toward $92K. Wrong if BTC closes below $70K (stop) or fails to reclaim $80K by end of Jan 2027.

Long TLT because $82 is the floor of its multi-year range with duration priced for restrictive real yields; any growth crack forces a flight-to-quality rally toward $88. Wrong if TLT prints a new range low below $79.20 — stopped there, thesis dead if no rally off the floor by end of Feb 2027.
Long GLD because the structural central-bank/debasement bid holds while gold consolidates ~8% below its cycle highs; measured move to $420. Wrong if GLD loses $362 by end of Dec 2026.

positions.thesis: Long GLD because elevated geopolitical residual risk, ongoing central-bank buying, and recent oil/yield pullback create near-term safe-haven bid while gold remains ~25% off highs; mispriced relative to structural demand. Wrong if December Fed hike solidifies and real yields spike further by end-November, breaking recent bounce support.

Long IWM because October equal-weight outperformance and small-cap rotation from mega-cap tech weakness signal broadening; November seasonality favors risk assets. Wrong if VIX stays elevated >25 and growth concerns reaccelerate by mid-December, pushing IWM back below recent lows.
